title: Prove the fixed-coordinate F4 all-p caller cost bound (no new κ)
body:
The fixed four-coordinate decoder on the classical F4 set of 24 rays cannot fund saving **0.00310045** with the declared path-caller invoice, ambient rank **h >= 7**, and nonnegative net helper cost. This is a **scoped negative result**, with **no new kappa or selected-frontier change**.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/37c3eb9ec87cc735a413a8fc20bf3cae2cc31e95/research/f4-coordinate-caller-bound/PROOF.md) · [Exact witnesses](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/37c3eb9ec87cc735a413a8fc20bf3cae2cc31e95/research/f4-coordinate-caller-bound/WITNESS.json) · [Receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/37c3eb9ec87cc735a413a8fc20bf3cae2cc31e95/research/f4-coordinate-caller-bound/EXPECTED.json) · [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/37c3eb9ec87cc735a413a8fc20bf3cae2cc31e95/research/f4-coordinate-caller-bound/SOURCES.json) · [Validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/37c3eb9ec87cc735a413a8fc20bf3cae2cc31e95/research/f4-coordinate-caller-bound/VALIDATION.md).

Four five-cliques force query ranks at least 5,5,5,5 for every allowed binary fitting matrix, including nonsymmetric matrices. Exact rational intervals check all **5,050 prefix splits** for pair counts 1 through 100. A separate histogram calculation checks the 100 balanced cases. Monotonicity in ambient rank and a negative concave tail extend the bound to every pair count. The greatest balanced upper margin is below -6.6777. The bill grants zero net helper cost and zero added fees, so a more costly implementation also fails this declared comparison.

The four coordinate factors and separate query charges are fixed. Other bases, rectangular decoders, h <= 6, negative net helper cost, shared query delivery, and changed callers remain open. The tested saving is a historical comparison point; no monotonicity in the saving or global ceiling is claimed. No native implementation or full multiplication theorem follows.

This publishes the [October 26 local finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19202809) at the donor's request to preserve this research chat. It adds the explicit model and all finite split checks to the existing clique and tail evidence. The [publication claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19364138) is limited to that result. Base and final canonical refresh: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8. The original local source context was `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`. Only this nine-file package is added.

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f4-coordinate-caller-bound
```

Expected marker: `PASS_F4_COORDINATE_ALL_P_BOUND` in both registered modes. Normal and optimized registered checks, ten-file committed-byte/mode checks, metadata/source pins, and official export integrity pass. Both modes also pass from a read-only Git-free export with `PATH=/nonexistent`; all eleven export files retain their hashes and modes. Six internal controls and actual exported source/witness mutations reject. The appended source failure is rejected before execution. The final head changes only validation prose after scientific commit `fe9d549cadae2dc005880f8ff2728dcfe148d5e2`.

The universal steps are written mathematics with exact finite corroboration. Independent human and proof-kernel review, hosted CI, and full native/caller/compiler/BIT/outer construction are not claimed. No Lean, Docker, predecessor scientific suite, or solver search was run for publication. Full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout; the pinned base is an ancestor.

Credit DreamingOfClouds's [char2-threshold record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a/research/char2-threshold/README.md) for the earlier F4 cost-24 search across 150 bases; this is not a new root set or a minimum over decoder bases. Credit zxv's [unchanged interval engine](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a/research/higher-moment-strictification/verify.py), Cinna Davis for the retained path-caller design, and Jacob Alan Sussman for productive mixed-target recursion. The identity-minor argument and concavity are classical. Source notices remain unchanged.

New witnesses, declared-caller specialization, proof and author-side checks: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0. A continuation needs changed factors, query delivery, or helper costs and a favorable whole invoice before a new construction search. [Scope and open question](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/37c3eb9ec87cc735a413a8fc20bf3cae2cc31e95/research/f4-coordinate-caller-bound/TASK.json).
